description: Stage3 core operational closure under explicit 2026-10-08 user priority. Reuse existing entities/layers/services and audit, no new report/Agent/schema/production actions or permission expansion. Fix verified source-link/state gaps with minimal complete files.

Prove invalid ID/source status/supplier/product/unit, duplicate source lines, post-submit source changes and no stock/movement/status mutation; guarded real SQL plus safe Release build/unit.
